headings.rules: Never use Inter for headings. Keep tight letter spacing. Ensure high contrast for readability.

colors.rules: Avoid pure black (#000000). Use #0A0A0E. For dark mode gradients, use subtle #0A0A0E to #1E1E28 shifts. Ensure WCAG AA 4.5:1 contrast ratios. Never use transparent backgrounds on headers/dropdowns.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use Glassmorphism for sticky headers and modals (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0A0A0E]/80 border-b border-white/10). Flat Solid for dashboard cards.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid borders in white/10 or primary/20 for interactive elements.
visual_enhancers.gradients: Do not use generic full-screen color gradients. Colorful gradients (Purple to Cyan) should only be used in active routes on the map or subtle text highlights.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Diffuse ambient shadows for elevated cards. Avoid muddy dropshadows.

component_name.forms: Shadcn UI Input, Select, Form. Highly customized for high contrast.
component_name.cards: Shadcn UI Card. No heavy shadows, rely on 1px border.
component_name.buttons: Pill-shaped. Primary actions use #00E5FF. SOS Button MUST be #FF3B30 with pulsing animation.
component_name.dialogs: Shadcn Dialog for Safety Check-ins and Emergency Contacts.

grids.dashboard_grid: Dense grid layout (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4). gap-4 or gap-6. Stretch children. Left sidebar for admin.
grids.user_app_grid: Mobile-first responsive grids. Map spans full screen behind content, or top half, with bottom sheets.
grids.spacing_scale: p-2, p-4, p-6, p-8. Use generous padding inside containers.

layouts.user_app: Top sticky header with Greeting & Profile. Main area: Leaflet Map (KIIT Lake/Bhubaneswar). Bottom sheet: Route inputs (D1, D2), Accessible Route toggles, SOS FAB.
layouts.driver_dashboard: Sidebar nav, top KPI cards, Main Map view, Right panel for crowding/delay reports.
layouts.admin_dashboard: Protected route. Sidebar. Main area: Large Live Map tracking fleet + Table of reported bugs/emergencies.

motion.transitions: Specific transitions only. transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease.
motion.animations: SOS Button pulses (animate-pulse). Map markers stagger-fade in. Greeting slide-down. Respect prefers-reduced-motion.

accessibility.contrast: APCA & WCAG AA standards. Text on map needs dark semi-transparent backdrop for contrast.
accessibility.voice_input: Include a microphone icon button for voice-to-text in destination inputs.
accessibility.aria: Use aria-labels for map markers, SOS button, and Voice Input.

media.icons: lucide-react for UI icons (MapPin, Mic, AlertTriangle, ShieldAlert, Accessibility).
media.map: React-Leaflet with Carto Dark Matter tiles for dark mode map. Must function offline gracefully showing 'no satellite connection'.

3d_libraries.decision: Not recommended for this utility app to keep performance high and credit usage low. Use 2D Maps (react-leaflet).

image_urls.description: Abstract Topographic Map lines for Hero Section or Auth screens background.
Purple and pink flowing wallpaper for offline mode overlay.
People sitting next to a bus, useful for the landing page or about section.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Do not use dark colors as gradients. Dark colors look good when used independently.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur). NEVER use completely transparent backgrounds for headers/dropdowns.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; }.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use lucide-react.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute. Example: data-testid='sos-button'
The app MUST have a dark mode toggle and support color gradient themes subtly.
For the Map, ensure it centers on KIIT Lake / Bhubaneswar region coordinates (approx 20.35, 85.81).
Offline map fallback should display the text 'no satellite connection' prominently.
Create and use .js/.jsx files only, NO .tsx/.ts files.
Ensure 'GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES' principles are maintained: robust contrast, clear hierarchical typography, and accessible interactive elements.

instructions_to_main_agent.project_setup: Set up a hybrid app with React Router. Routes: / (User App), /driver (Driver Dashboard), /admin (Admin Dashboard). Use .js/.jsx.
instructions_to_main_agent.map_implementation: Use react-leaflet. Display markers for D1 and D2 destinations, Police Stations, and Live location. Make sure map tiles have a dark mode variant.
instructions_to_main_agent.sos_feature: Implement a floating action button (FAB) for SOS. Clicking it should trigger a location sharing flow and alert via toast.
instructions_to_main_agent.accessibility_features: Include voice input simulation (button that fills input), readable fonts, high contrast.
instructions_to_main_agent.safety_checkin: Implement a modal (Shadcn Dialog) for Safety Check-ins asking for 'Name' and 'Alternate Phone Number'.
instructions_to_main_agent.greeting: Display a personalized greeting on login/logout.
instructions_to_main_agent.bug_report: Add a form to submit crowding/delays or bugs, linked to the Admin dashboard view.
